verdict.rationale: Revenue recognition is a fair question for a billing platform like Lago, but the evidence pack never documents ASC 606 / IFRS 15 recognition, deferred revenue schedules, or audit-ready recognition reports. The revenue analytics dashboards with CSV export are an adjacent feature, not revenue recognition. A community user also asked whether Lago offers revenue recognition and said they could not find it in the docs.

support.subject: As a finance lead, revenue is recognized on an ASC 606 / IFRS 15 basis — deferred revenue schedules and audit-ready recognition reports straight from billing data
